_antialiasingNote: AntialiasingMode: 0=None, 1=FXAA (noclip default), 2=MSAAx4. Pinned purely so two runs are comparable -- the value lives in localStorage, not in the code, so an unpinned baseline would diff against another browser profile for reasons unrelated to any change.
_comment: Project-specific config for the generic `webshot` tool. Everything about browsers, GPU,
waiting, settling and diffing lives in webshot; nc.mjs knows about noclip; this file is
the only part that is specific to a game.
saveState   a noclip share-link ShareData string -- easiest to author: run
`./nc.mjs watch <view>`, fly to a good spot, copy the `;ShareData=...`
out of the URL bar. Needs nothing from the scene code.
fitScene    derive the camera from the scene's worldBounds; survives changes to the
importer's scale or origin, but the scene must publish worldBounds
`reference` is real-game footage: reported, never gating. Only blessed baselines gate,
because a WebGL re-implementation is never pixel-equal to captured hardware footage.
